    """Convert a v1 record to v2 format, or return v2 record as equal copy.
    
    v1 format: {"id", "name", "remote": "yes"/"no"}
    v2 format: {"version": 2, "id", "title", "work_mode": "remote"/"office"/"unknown"}
    
    name becomes title
    remote yes -> remote, no -> office, missing -> unknown
    any other remote value raises ValueError
    Never modifies the input; v2 records returned as equal copy (idempotent).
    """
    # If already v2, return a copy to preserve idempotency and immutability
    if record.get("version") == 2:
        return {"id": record["id"], "title": record["title"], "work_mode": record["work_mode"], "version": 2}
    
    # v1 record: must not modify the input, so work on a copy
    record = dict(record)
    
    # Map name -> title
    title = record.pop("name")
    
    # Determine work_mode from remote field
    remote = record.pop("remote", None)
    if remote == "yes":
        work_mode = "remote"
    elif remote == "no":
        work_mode = "office"
    elif remote is None or remote == "missing":
        work_mode = "unknown"
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid remote value: {remote!r}")
    
    return {"id": record["id"], "title": title, "work_mode": work_mode, "version": 2}"}}}]
